name: VersaBank Real Bank Deposit Token USD
oneLiner: USDVB is VersaBank USA’s pilot dollar deposit token, issued one-for-one against bank deposits ahead of conditional commercialization.
collateral: Pre-launch bank deposit token: one USDVB represents US$1 on deposit with VersaBank USA National Association. This is exposure to a bank deposit and its balance sheet, not a separately segregated 100%-cash reserve trust. Federal deposit-insurance eligibility remains subject to regulatory confirmation.
pegMechanism: The pilot issues one USDVB per US$1 deposited with VersaBank USA, with issuance and redemption through VersaVault and access/control through VersaView on planned Algorand, Ethereum and Stellar deployments. Ordinary external-holder transfer and redemption rights, minimums, fees, timing and capacity are unpublished.
launchPhaseDetail: Internal USDVB pilot announced August 26, 2025, with limited designated external deposit-partner/client deployment planned. Pilot is not a supported catalog launch-phase enum, so no launchPhase is assigned. Commercial launch requires the bank’s stated OCC non-objection process; the September 1, 2026 filing still seeks regulatory confirmation of deposit-insurance eligibility and the ability to pay interest. No current launch window or official chain-qualified asset addresses are established.

milestones.title: VersaBank USA launches internal USDVB pilot
milestones.description: The bank describes phased testing and limited external partner/client expansion before commercialization, with one USDVB per US$1 on deposit.

milestones.title: Quarterly filing retains conditional tokenized-deposit strategy
milestones.description: The bank seeks regulatory confirmation of insurance eligibility and the ability to pay interest; the filing does not establish a public USDVB commercial launch.
